caption:
Signs your credit habits are better than you think. ✅
• You pay at least the minimum every month
• Your balances are well below your limits
• You haven't opened five cards this year
• You check your reports for errors
Not all of these? Pick one and start there.
Which one are you doing already?
first_comment: Which of the four do you already do? 👇

card.headline: 4 signs you're doing better than you think.
card.sub: On time. Low balances. Few new cards. Checked reports.
